resources.string: Who you owe, and who owes you. When a caller asks you to send money, it shows up as what you owe them. When they say they\'ll pay you, Request sends them a Solana Pay link to your own wallet. Only addresses you save yourself. Never one heard on a call. Nothing is sent until you approve it in your wallet.
No one yet. Add someone, or add them from a payment card.

Save only an address the person gave you themselves. Double-check it: a transfer can\'t be undone.

resources.string: Sol can answer the calls you don\'t pick up on this phone and leave you a note. Two steps, once: verify your number, then turn on forwarding with your carrier.
Waiting for your call. The line recognises your number and hangs up by itself in a second; Sol doesn\'t answer it. Your carrier\'s normal rate for a call applies.
Not verified yet. No SMS: you call the secretary line once from this phone.
Enter your number with the country code, e.g. +380 63 123 45 67.
No connection. Try again in a moment.
Forward missed, busy and unreachable calls (**004#)

Each button opens your dialer with a standard GSM code; you press call and your carrier sets it up. Your carrier may charge for forwarded calls. Some carriers (and CDMA networks) use their own app or codes instead.

How Sol knows a forwarded call is yours: if your carrier passes your number along with the call, it matches your verified number. If not, it matches the caller your phone just screened (Solarchik must be the call screening app; that covers numbers outside your contacts). A call the line can\'t match goes to the line owner\'s demo inbox, not to you.
